turns.text: Hello, this is an automated call from the Hillside research team. I'm an AI assistant, not a person, and you can ask to speak with a person at any time. May I speak with James?
Yes, this is James.
Thank you. I'm calling for your check-in about how you've been feeling since your last study visit. It takes about five minutes. Is now a good time?
Yes, now is fine. Go ahead.

Thank you. I'll ask about some common symptoms. For each one, tell me the answer that fits best. In the past 7 days, how often have you had loose or watery bowel movements? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Never. I haven't had any of that.
In the past 7 days, how often have you felt sick to your stomach, as if you might throw up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Never. I've been feeling fine.
In the past 7 days, how often have you thrown up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Never. I haven't thrown up at all.
In the past 7 days, have you had a fever, chills, or shaking?
No, I haven't had any fever or chills.
In the past 7 days, how much shortness of breath have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
None. I haven't had any trouble breathing.
In the past 7 days, how much dizziness have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
None. I haven't been dizzy at all.
In the past 7 days, how much tiredness or lack of energy have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
None. I've had plenty of energy.
In the past 7 days, have you had a new skin rash?
No, I haven't had any new rash.
Have you or your family noticed any new confusion, trouble finding words, or unusual sleepiness?
No, nothing like that. I've been feeling fine.
Since your last study visit, have you started, stopped, or changed any medicines, including ones from the pharmacy or vitamins?
No, I haven't made any changes to my medicines.
Since your last study visit, have you gone to an emergency room, urgent care, or another doctor?
No, I haven't had any visits like that.
Is there anything else you would like the nurse to know?
No, nothing else. I've been feeling fine.
Thank you, James. The research team will review your answers. If this is an emergency, hang up and call 9-1-1. Goodbye.
